candidates.equivalent_settings_merged: DBN only: num_tempi when the tempo range has at most 30 frame intervals; meter_change_prob for a single meter
candidates.origin: every distinct setting of this decoder that the August searches of this experiment evaluated and that the reference decoder accepts

notes: Parameters were selected on validation songs only. The decision to re-rank the searched settings instead of running a new search was taken after comparing both on the salsa specialist, including on its test songs.
reason: The August searches scored settings on stored features, whose frames are centred about 24 ms later than those of the live frontend, and a shared setting lets validation songs of one fold influence the setting used on them as test songs of another fold. The selection was repeated on 7 October 2026 because the ported 1D decoder now runs every setting that the reference accepts, so the candidate list no longer depends on the port. Data, scoring and rule are those of 6 October 2026.

stage_config.activation_source: live scores of the ported engine: each fold model on that fold's validation songs, uncached streaming frontend
stage_config.aggregation: track mean per dataset, harmonic mean of beat and downbeat, mean over datasets
stage_config.decoder: ported 1D decoder of mir-embedded-pp (host library) after its completion on 7 October 2026: N widths and state-boundary mode included

supersedes: the per-fold selection of 6 October 2026, whose candidates were limited to the settings the ported 1D decoder could run then (B widths, activation-triggered output)

tools.decoder_library: mir-embedded-pp 8aa3c74, host library built from source
